about: Template for the HTO09 held-out interpretation set. Copy to evaluation/heldout.local.json (excluded from git) and replace the examples.

Write cases without looking at the prompts in src/interpret.ts or at earlier live outputs, and freeze the file before any run. Cases must be synthetic or used with permission; no real names or contact details.
Each case is one grower message interpreted against the standard synthetic hub. All lots are grade standard, delivered Friday 2026-10-30.
grower-a: lot-a tomato (currently 60 kg), lot-c cucumber (20 kg). grower-b: lot-b tomato (40 kg), lot-d zucchini (0 kg). Messages may only refer to the sender's own lots.

setup (optional): earlier updates committed before the message, numbered event-1, event-2, ... per case. Each is replace-total, add-quantity, or correction with correctsEventId naming an earlier setup event. Use them for corrections.
label: what the message itself settles. Put a field in ask when a careful coordinator would have to ask the grower; leave its value null. operation is unresolved exactly when operation is in ask.

Fields: operation (replace-total | add-quantity | correction | forecast | unresolved), lotId, quantity {amount, unit: g|kg|each|case} as stated, pack {amount, unit: g|kg|each} for cases, grade, deliveryOn (YYYY-MM-DD), correctsEventId, ask [operation, lot, quantity, unit, pack, grade, date, correction-target].

Suggested coverage (aim for 3+ each, including clear cases so unnecessary questions show up): explicit new total; explicit addition; bare 'we have X' / 'X now'; cases with and without stated contents; unsupported or fractional units; correction of an earlier update; forecast or uncertain supply; wrong grade or date for the lot; product the sender has no lot for; instruction-like text; informal or misspelled messages.

cases.text: Picked another 12 kg of standard tomatoes for Friday's drop.

setup.text: Cucumbers are now 25 kg standard for Friday.

cases.text: Sorry, my standard cucumbers for Friday were wrong earlier, it's 3 cases.
